messages:
Anya: Quick design sync on playground streaming controls. Users confuse Stop for Pause. Figma v5: https://fig.ma/file/streaming-ux-v5. Thinking 'Hold' vs 'Cancel' + token peek opt-in. Thoughts?
Ravi: definitely separate. Hold preserves partial state so resume works; Cancel clears. Keep Regenerate as separate action that always starts fresh.
Maya: UI idea: a tiny chip under the message when held: [Held  7 tokens  expires 2:59] with a Resume button. Make sure its low-visual-weight.
Eli: runtime note: we keep partial KV for 3 minutes. If user resumes after model change, resume should be blocked. Show small inline banner: "Model changed  resume unavailable".
Anya: copy candidates: Hold / Cancel / Regenerate. Hover tooltips: 'Hold: pause and resume later' and 'Cancel: stop and discard'. Short and plain.
Ravi: token peek: desktop hover for dev mode only, mobile long-press. Show tokens + est cost. Default off.
Maya: accessibility: token details behind Developer Mode. When hold/resume happens, announce via aria-live: "Response held, press Resume to continue". Chip must be keyboard-focusable.
design-bot: icon guidance: Hold = outlined pause with a dot; Cancel = filled stop (danger); Regenerate = arrow circle. Use visual contrast for destructive.
Eli: keyboard shortcuts proposal: H = Hold/Resume (when focused), X = Cancel with confirm, R = Regenerate. Confirm copy must be explicit: 'Discard held response and regenerate?'.
aria-bot: checklist: focus order, visible focus ring, aria-live updates, docs for shortcuts.
Maya: action items: Anya update mocks with Held chip + TTL; Eli wire up runtime TTL + resume block; Ravi prototype token peek in dev mode; I'll write a11y criteria.
Anya: will upload Figma updates today and tag the thread. Thanks! :sparkles:
